title: Jacob Odqvist - Articles on Car Auctions & Enthusiast Culture
description: Read articles and posts by Jacob Odqvist about car auctions, classic cars and enthusiast culture. Expert insights and reports from Bidders Highway.
mainHtml:
Jacob Odqvist

Jacob Odqvist's lifelong passion for cars and motorcycles led him to found Bidders Highway in 2022. With Golden Lions and Grand Prix awards from Cannes under his belt, Jacob has combined the tact of an advertiser with the passion of a vehicle lover who gone for a ride with Steve Jobs' in his BMW Z8 in Silicon Valley and has raced the Gotland Grand National on a 950 cc Dakar bike weighing 200 kilos.

G-Wagen — the classic with a thousand faces

From military jeep to luxury icon: the story behind the Mercedes-Benz G-Class, the generations from W460 to the electric G 580, what to look out for when buying — and the G-Wagens we've sold and have up for auction right now.

September 09, 2026 09:17

On the road before the world wakes up

The house is still asleep as I close the door behind me. Coffee, keys, an empty suburban street. The summer pace has already set in—it feels a bit like Tomas Ledin’s "En dag på stranden," except it’s five in the morning and I’m heading in the wrong direction for a day at the beach. No rush yet. On my way to the garage, I see a sky that has already begun to brighten in the east.

July 28, 2026 14:00

The CEO has the floor - June

June was a strong month for us—with high sales volumes across every category. The market is active, and the data shows there are fantastic deals to be made. At the same time, it remains a buyer’s market overall, and the tricky part is the reserve prices. Many people still value their cars based on sentiment rather than market reality—which is only human, but it impacts the bidding. One’s own car always feels a bit more valuable than someone else’s identical model. That is where the two—seller and market—meet, usually at the end of the auction. Last month, I promised we would take a closer look at that specific moment. That is where almost everything is decided.

July 14, 2026 13:00

The CEO has the floor - May

Last month I wrote that it is not the seller who sets the price, but the market. This sparked some reactions, mostly in agreement but also the occasional objection. The most common one went something like this: if the market determines everything, what can the seller himself influence? The answer is: more than you think. Just not in the way most people try to.

June 18, 2026 12:00

The CEO has the floor - January

The year has had an unusually strong start. Already in the first weeks of the year, we saw an influx of objects that was three times higher than the same period last year. This is no coincidence – rather a sign of the times. The market for used cars, and especially enthusiast vehicles, is in motion.

February 18, 2026 16:00

Sometimes the best car in the world is just the one that takes you home.

We at Bidders Highway love to write about driving pleasure. About cars that awaken something in the body – good steering, a nice chassis, the feeling that man and machine speak the same language. But driving pleasure comes in more forms than those where you measure rpm, times or tire wear.

January 08, 2026 13:00

The best sports car season of the year – For real!

Most sports car owners wake up when the sun peeks out in April and you roll your winter-hibernating 911 out of the garage. For me, it's the opposite. The best season of the year begins when frost settles like a thin blanket over the asphalt tracks and the summer tire faction starts talking about "storage."

December 09, 2025 11:00

The CEO has the floor - November

November is going down in history as our strongest month to date, with a sell-through rate that has sometimes reached 90%. That’s amazing, but perhaps not a coincidence. What we’re seeing happen right now is what happens when sellers really start to understand – and exploit – the full potential of the auction format.

November 28, 2025 12:00

Sot is back – and what a week it was!

There is something very special about driving a car you really know. A car you have had, missed – and got back. Like finding a pair of old favorite jeans forgotten in a box out at the summer cottage. For me, it's about my old Porsche 996 Carrera 2, a -98 with a manual transmission, rear-wheel drive and diff. A car that I have put my own stamp on over the years, with modifications that make it perfect for both everyday use and trackday. This week has really reminded me of why we love cars – and why I am so glad that Sot is back home.

October 09, 2025 15:00

The Porsche that found home

"Sot" has found its home again. Seven years ago, my brother and I bought our first Porsche. Our wallets were limited, but our requirements were crystal clear – it had to be a 911. So we chose perhaps the most unloved of them all, the 996. A black, fairly naked car with no equipment, imported from France, with an engine already changed, sitting on questionable Chinese coilovers and with an exterior that had seen better days. But it was mechanically sound – and for us, it was a golden opportunity.

September 17, 2025 16:00

The CEO has the floor - August

August is often a slightly quieter month on the auction scene, and so it is this year. But beneath the surface, it is noticeable that we are facing a trend shift. I see bidding continuing to be lively and interest high, but willingness to pay has slowed compared to recent years. At the same time, we have had a very strong influx of objects – something that bodes well for the autumn. It is also extra nice that our No Reserve auctions have received attention and resulted in several really successful closings.

September 15, 2025 16:00

The CEO has the floor - June

The month of June began with anticipation – not least because May, which started slowly, ended at record speed. We were curious to see if the trend would continue. It did – and more. June was an outstanding month on Bidders Highway, with many strong closings and continued great engagement from both buyers and sellers.

July 15, 2025 17:40

The CEO has the floor - February

A prize-winning 1938 Dodge and a 1956 Corvette were some of the highlights from February's auctions. The idea that you can't buy a cab in the winter doesn't seem to be true. In fact, we often see better bids during the winter months when it's easier to break through the noise. Most often, it's the sellers who have to be convinced that the time is right, the buyers are there and always ready.

March 12, 2025 10:35

The CEO has the floor - January

January is always a bit of a strange month from a sales perspective. It is fickle and polarizing. Some have fresh New Year's resolutions that slow down any impulse purchases while others are hungry for more. Add to that that January 2025, was short, started late and it took a while for us car geeks to digest the food and get started after the Christmas food coma. Then it happened, full speed again, and what a start it was!

The CEO has the floor - December/January

Dear enthusiasts, it's time for us to make a New Year's resolution. Not only to strive for increased joy in life but to counteract the possible risk that many older cars risk falling into oblivion during the generational changes in our own ranks. The resolution is - Get out and drive your cars!
